operation.body:
### Goal

Complete readiness-safe runtime bootstrap for Project Execution #2: confirm the proposed stack, document architecture direction, verify private workflow materialization and applicable automation entry points, and update project readiness evidence so the next goal can scaffold the Rails application.

### Acceptance criteria

- Record confirmed stack choice (Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML) in `.ai/project/decisions.md` and the project decision status table in `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md`, resolving the relevant `deferred` rows that readiness can close without an application scaffold.
- Fill `.ai/docs/architecture-direction.md` with the intended system shape, boundaries, and principles for Feedback Inbox (local-only, no auth, synthetic data).
- Update the **Project readiness** table honestly: stack profile selected, automation/workflow verification noted with concrete evidence (commands run and outcomes), and defer only application setup/run/test commands to the next scaffold-producing goal per `.ai/onboarding/bootstrap-checklist.md`.
- Update `.ai/project/roadmap.md` milestone states to reflect completed readiness work.
- Run `bash tests/test-adapter.sh` and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement product behaviour (no FR-001–FR-008 features), do not edit `docs/security-review.md`, and do not change unrelated demo goal #3 scope.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Change only documentation and project overlay files required for readiness; no application code or Gemfile yet.

### Out of scope

Rails scaffold, database migrations, inbox UI, tests for application behaviour, security checklist work, and changes to bootstrap CI workflow unless required to document verification.

### Relevant context

Bootstrap PR #1 is merged. Application implementation has not started. Requirements and roadmap list readiness before demonstration. See `.ai/docs/full-workflow.md` section 2b and `.ai/onboarding/bootstrap-checklist.md`.
